"""Camera-guided DivideBasins controller for the live eai-standard service."""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
DT = 0.05

def pack(q, grip=-1.0, base=(0, 0, 0), torso=0.0, mode=-1.0):
    a = np.zeros(13, dtype=np.float64)
    a[:7] = q
    a[7] = grip
    a[8:11] = base
    a[11] = torso
    a[12] = mode
    return a

def current(r):
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[CAM], include_depth=True, video="none")
    n = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return n[4:11].copy(), n[26:29].copy(), o

def move_joints(r, q, grip=-1.0, steps=12, note=""):
    a = np.tile(pack(q, grip), (steps, 1))
    return r.submit("joint_position", a, interpolate="hold", cameras=[CAM], video="none", note=note)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    r = Robot()
    q0, p0, obs = current(r)
    print("start q", q0, "eef", p0, "time_left", obs.meta["time_left_s"])
    J = np.zeros((3,7))
    for j in range(7):
        q = q0.copy(); q[j] += 0.035
        res = move_joints(r, q, steps=8, note=f"small safe kinematic probe joint {j+1}")
        n = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
        p1 = n[26:29].copy()
        J[:,j] = (p1 - p0) / 0.035
        res = move_joints(r, q0, steps=8, note=f"return from kinematic probe joint {j+1}")
        n = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
        p0 = n[26:29].copy()
        print("joint", j+1, "J", J[:,j], "return_eef", p0)
    np.save("/app/output/jacobian.npy", J)
    print("J=\n", J)

"""Camera-guided controller for the live RoboCasa365 DivideBasins episode.

Uses only RGB/depth camera frames, camera calibration, and measured robot proprioception.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
PANDA_LIMITS = np.array([[-2.8973, 2.8973], [-1.7628, 1.7628], [-2.8973, 2.8973],
                         [-3.0718, -0.0698], [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-0.0175, 3.7525],
                         [-2.8973, 2.8973]])

def pack(q, grip=-1.0):
    a = np.zeros(13, dtype=np.float64)
    a[:7] = q
    a[7] = grip
    a[12] = -1.0
    return a

def state_from_result(res):
    n = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    R = np.asarray(res.meta["cameras"][CAM]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
    return n[4:11].copy(), n[26:29].copy(), R

def observe(r, depth=False):
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[CAM], include_depth=depth, video="none")
    q, p, R = state_from_result(o)
    return q, p, R, o

def command(r, q, grip=-1.0, steps=10, note=""):
    return r.submit("joint_position", np.tile(pack(q, grip), (steps, 1)),
                    interpolate="hold", cameras=[CAM], video="none", note=note)

def rotvec(R):
    c = np.clip((np.trace(R) - 1.0) / 2.0, -1.0, 1.0)
    angle = np.arccos(c)
    v = np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2], R[0,2]-R[2,0], R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
    if angle < 1e-7:
        return 0.5*v
    return angle/(2*np.sin(angle))*v

def calibrate(r):
    """Estimate the 6D end-effector Jacobian from small arm commands and proprioception."""
    q0, p0, R0, _ = observe(r)
    J = np.zeros((6,7), dtype=float)
    eps = 0.035
    for j in range(7):
        qt = q0.copy(); qt[j] += eps
        res = command(r, qt, steps=10, note=f"small safe Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
        q1, p1, R1 = state_from_result(res)
        dq = q1[j] - q0[j]
        if abs(dq) < 0.008:
            command(r, q0, steps=12, note="return from small Jacobian probe")
            raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j+1} probe moved only {dq:.4f} rad")
        J[:3,j] = (p1-p0)/dq
        J[3:,j] = rotvec(R1 @ R0.T)/dq
        command(r, q0, steps=10, note=f"return from Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
    q0, p0, R0, _ = observe(r)
    return q0, p0, R0, J

def pixel_world(o, u, v):
    cam = o.meta["cameras"][CAM]
    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    z = float(o.depth[CAM][0, v, u])
    if not np.isfinite(z) or z <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"no depth at target pixel {(u,v)}")
    pc = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1], -z, 1.0])
    return (T @ pc)[:3]

def servo_pose(r, target_p, target_R, max_iters=14):
    for k in range(max_iters):
        q, p, R, J = calibrate(r)
        ep = np.asarray(target_p)-p
        er = rotvec(np.asarray(target_R) @ R.T)
        print(f"servo {k}: eef={p.round(3)} dp={ep.round(3)} dr={er.round(3)} left={r.status().get('time_left_s')}")
        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.018 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.10:
            return q, p, R
        dp = ep.copy()
        nr = np.linalg.norm(dp)
        if nr > 0.045: dp *= 0.045/nr
        dr = er.copy()
        nr = np.linalg.norm(dr)
        if nr > 0.12: dr *= 0.12/nr
        dq = np.linalg.pinv(J, rcond=1e-4) @ np.r_[dp, dr]
        largest = np.max(np.abs(dq))
        if largest > 0.18: dq *= 0.18/largest
        qgoal = np.clip(q+dq, PANDA_LIMITS[:,0]+0.01, PANDA_LIMITS[:,1]-0.01)
        res = command(r, qgoal, steps=14, note=f"camera-guided pose step {k}")
        if res.done: raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {res.meta.get('reason')}")
    raise RuntimeError(f"pose servo did not converge to {target_p}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    r = Robot()
    q, p, R, o = observe(r, depth=True)
    print("start", q.round(3), p.round(3), "left", o.meta["time_left_s"])
    # The wood-handled utensil is at the visible handle in the left basin.
    item = pixel_world(o, 130, 130)
    print("left-basin item point", item.round(3))
    # Move to a safe hover point above it; inspect before descending to grasp.
    hover = item + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.35])
    print("hover target", hover.round(3))
    servo_pose(r, hover, R)
    q, p, R, o = observe(r, depth=True)
    print("hover complete", p.round(3), "left", o.meta["time_left_s"])
    o.save("/app/output/hover")
